ns2:section.sectionText: The course will cover the process of game design and development, resulting in a final class project of a game demo using the Torque Engine by GarageGames. No experience with Torque is necessary but being familiar with programs such as Game Builder and Adobe Flash is a plus. Issues covered in this course will include accessibility for gamers with disabilities, as well as mature sexual and violent themes. Student will also receive content and design support from game industry veterans and game companies. Please contact the instructor, Michelle Hinn at hinn@uiuc.edu with any inquiries.
